source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Griffith's experiment (PDF 120-121).

blocks.text: 1928 mein British biologist Frederick Griffith ne aik bimari phailane wale (pathogenic) bacterium, Streptococcus pneumoniae, par kaam kiya. Us ne is bacterium ke do strains (qismein) dekhe:
“S-type” strain par polysaccharide ka ghilaf (coat) hota hai aur us ki colony hamwar (“smooth”) nazar aati hai.
“R-type” strain par polysaccharide coat nahin hota aur woh khurdari (“rough”) colony banata hai.

Griffith ne S-type bacteria chuhon (mice) mein inject kiye to woh virulent (jaan lewa) saabit hue: chuhon ko pneumonia hua aur woh mar gaye. R-type bacteria inject kiye to chuhon par koi asar nahin hua. Griffith ne socha ke S-type ka jaan lewa asar shayad us ke polysaccharide coat ki wajah se hai, jo use host (mezbaan) ke immune system (jism ka bimari se larne wala system) se bachata hai. Phir us ne garmi se maare hue (heat-killed) S-type bacteria inject kiye; chuhe tandurust rahe. Wajah mazeed samajhne ke liye us ne heat-killed S-type (virulent magar murda) aur zinda R-type (non-virulent) ka mixture inject kiya. Us ka khayal tha ke chuhe beemar nahin honge, lekin chuhon ko pneumonia hua aur woh mar gaye. Murda chuhon ka khoon dekha to us mein bohat se zinda S-type bacteria mile.

blocks.alt: Chaar qataarein, har aik mein bacteria ka daira, syringe aur chuha. S-type bacteria (ghilaf wale): chuhe mar gaye. R-type bacteria (bina ghilaf): chuhe sehatmand rahe. Garmi se maare S-type: chuhe sehatmand rahe. Garmi se maare S-type aur zinda R-type ka mixture: chuhe mar gaye aur khoon mein zinda S-type bacteria mile.
blocks.caption: Figure 19.6: Griffith ka tajarba (kitab ki Figure 19.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Griffith ne nateeja nikala ke polysaccharide coat banane aur virulence ki maloomat heat-killed S-type bacteria se zinda R-type bacteria mein chali gayi. Is liye R-type bacteria ne polysaccharide coat bana liya aur virulent S-type mein badal gaye. Us ne is amal ko transformation kaha, yaani genetic material ka aik jandar se doosre mein jana, jis se lene wale jandar ki genetic banawat badal jati hai. Griffith yeh maloom na kar saka ke murda S-type se zinda R-type mein jane wala material kimiyai taur par kya tha (DNA, protein ya dono).

blocks.title: Information
blocks.text:
1944 mein teen scientists, Avery, MacLeod aur McCarty, ne transforming principle (badalne wala maadda) dhoonda. Unhon ne murda S-type bacteria se proteins nikal diye aur baqi ko zinda R-type ke saath mila kar chuhon mein inject kiya: chuhe phir bhi beemar hue aur un mein zinda S-type bacteria mile. Matlab R-type ko S-type banane ke zimmedar proteins nahin.
Phir unhon ne murda S-type se saara DNA nikal diya aur use zinda R-type ke saath mila kar inject kiya. Is baar transformation nahin hui aur chuhe tandurust rahe.
Unhon ne nateeja nikala: “transforming principle ki bunyadi unit DNA hai”.

blocks.prompt: Heat-killed S-type aur zinda R-type ke mixture ne chuhe kyun maar diye?
blocks.explanation: Murda S-type ke material (jo baad mein DNA saabit hua) ne zinda R-type bacteria ko coat wale, jaan lewa S-type mein badal diya (transformation). Yeh naye S-type bacteria barhe aur pneumonia ka sabab bane.

items: S-type: coat, smooth colony, jaan lewa; R-type: coat nahin, rough colony, bezarar.
Heat-killed S + zinda R ne chuhe maare: transformation.
Avery, MacLeod, McCarty (1944): transforming principle DNA hai.
